newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady. Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $21.00-21.50 per cwt.; Medium grain traded mostly at $19.00; Second heads were steady and Brewers remain in very tight supply with few quotes at $14.25-15.00.
Rice by-products were uneven, bran was steady to $3.00 higher, millfeed was steady to $3.00 lower.
In California, rice prices were steady, bran was steady to $2.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings For the week ending March 15, 1997, at the Port of Sacramento the Sanko Prelude loaded 20,790 mt of U.S. No. 1 Medium grain bulk rice destined for Turkey.

Inspections of California rice for export For the week ending March 15, 1997, there were 458,562 cwt of U.S. No 1 Medium grain milled rice inspected. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 is 7,771,645 cwt compared to 5,548,093 cwt a year ago.
Feed by-products prices (dollars per short ton, FOB mills).
